research.searchCoverage: Official BambooHR REST HTTP Basic (API key as username, x as password), GET /api/v1/company_information, GET /api/v1/meta/fields, GET /api/v1/employees, GET /api/v1/employees/{id}, required company subdomain host, Bamboo HR LLC Utah identity, and dated incident search (BambooHR + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. February 2019 TraxPayroll unauthorized access is a historical related-payroll incident; the core HRIS REST edition is not asserted as currently compromised. This is not a breach-free claim.

exception.authority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 for historical non-China incidents
exception.incident: February 2019 TraxPayroll unauthorized third-party access attempted to divert payroll deposits and exposed employee names, SSNs, residence/employment state, wage types, and tax codes. Detected 2019-02-13.
exception.remediation: BambooHR notified potentially affected individuals and offered 12 months of credit monitoring and identity restoration. Public reporting describes TraxPayroll, not a current unresolved core HRIS REST compromise.
exception.residualRisk: Historical payroll-adjacent exposure. Live authentication unverified.
exception.adoption: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 explicitly permits historical non-China incident adoption for BambooHR REST operations, including the Composio-depth writes added in v0.2.0.
exception.usefulness: Company, field, employee, ATS, file, time-off, benefit, report, and metadata operations cover the Composio BAMBOOHR toolkit while preserving origin JSON contracts.

research.searchCoverage: Official BambooHR REST uses HTTP Basic with the API key as username on https://{companyDomain}.bamboohr.com. GET company_information, meta/fields, employees list/get confirmed on 2026-09-13. Operator is Bamboo HR LLC (Lindon, Utah). Host is a required stored company subdomain plus bounded *.bamboohr.com (Algolia/Grafana-style). Dated incident search recorded the 2019 TraxPayroll historical payroll incident.

incidents.remediation: Incident detected 2019-02-13; potentially affected individuals notified; 12 months of credit monitoring offered.
incidents.residualRisk: Historical payroll-adjacent exposure. Live authentication unverified.
